# expo-callkit-telecom

> LiveCommunicationKit and Core-Telecom for React Native and Expo — VoIP push, incoming call UI, LiveKit-friendly audio. A modern react-native-callkeep alternative.

`expo-callkit-telecom` is an Expo module (Swift + Kotlin) that presents calls with Apple's LiveCommunicationKit on iOS, through ios-voip-sdk, and Jetpack `androidx.core-telecom` on Android, behind one typed TypeScript conversations API. The module presents calls in the system call UI, coordinates call audio and decodes VoIP pushes; the host app owns the media (LiveKit, plain WebRTC, etc.). An Expo config plugin handles entitlements, background modes, microphone permission, ringtone bundling, and FCM service registration at prebuild time.

Minimum platforms for v2: iOS 26.0, Android API 26, Expo SDK 55. Upstream v1 (iOS 16.0, CallKit) was verified end-to-end on iOS 26 + Android 15 with Expo SDK 55, React Native 0.83, the New Architecture enabled, and the LiveKit React Native SDK.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/): features, supported versions, and authoritative references for LiveCommunicationKit, Core-Telecom, VoIP push, and LiveKit.
- [Getting started](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/getting-started): install, config plugin setup, the conversations API, and push tokens.
- [VoIP push payload](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/voip-push): canonical `IncomingCallPayload` shape, APNs VoIP (PushKit) payload, and FCM data-message payload.
- [Platform notes](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/platform-notes): iOS / Android requirements and background keep-alive guidance.
- [vs react-native-callkeep](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/vs-callkeep): side-by-side comparison, when to pick which, and migration sketch.
- [API reference](https://mfairley.github.io/expo-callkit-telecom/api/): generated TypeScript reference for conversations, the handler, commands, reports, events, audio routes, push tokens, and hooks.
